name: Headband of Premonition, Greater
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 5th; Slot headband; Price 60,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Visually distinguishable from the headband of premonition by a more intricately engraved silver band and two additional crystals (set on either side of the central cabachon), the greater headband of premonition grants its wearer all the benefits of its regular counterpart on a continuous basis.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, premonition; Cost 30,000 gp.
